

**Sailfish OS 5.1.0.11 / aarch64:** Install the shared `sailfish-gnome` runtime
from [Sailfish GNOME releases](https://github.com/trufae/sailfishos-gnome/releases)
alongside the `harbour-parla` RPM. GTK4/libadwaita are now shared between apps
instead of bundled inside Parla. The `-devel` package is only needed in the
SDK. See the [installation instructions](https://github.com/trufae/parla/blob/main/dist/sailfishos/README.md).
